title: Tab line, reminded
description: Tab line, with a remind setting for workers that forget their line: a short line under a worker's card, written by the user or by the worker itself.

remind.description: How hard workers are reminded of their line: in the brief of each worker started or resumed, with the line it carries (start); and at each prompt too (prompt). A floor's own value wins on its workers.

line.description: The worker's tab line as last written; a blank one or null clears it.

guidance.brief: Set a short line under your card saying what you are on, when that changes.
guidance.full: Your tab line is a few words under your card, like a named terminal tab, so the user can tell at a glance what you are on. Set it when you start a task and when the task changes, not for every step: `tower x tabline facts/line --value 'writing the migration'`. Keep it under 80 characters, plain words, no paths. Keep it when you go idle: it then says what you last worked on. The user may set it too: if they did, leave theirs unless your task changed.

words.label: Name tab
words.hint: A short line of your own under this worker's card
